versions.status: sourced from NSE circulars; scope is Exchange Traded Funds other than Gold ETFs; Gold ETFs are NOT covered because NSE set their tick one security at a time (Rs 0.05 or Rs 0.01, changed by separate circulars such as NSE/CMTR/43225, 46234, 47424, 49065, 50551, 50899, 50985, 59407, 59529, 60469 and 60943), so a caller must never resolve a Gold ETF from this table; effective_from is the start of the Phase 62 research window, not the date the regime began; effective_to is the day before the 2025-04-15 price-linked table, and the exclusion of ETFs from that table after 2024-05-24 is stated in NSE/CMTR/62174 and NSE/CMTR/67774, with no CMTR-feed circular revising a non-Gold ETF tick in between
versions.reference_price_rule: not used: one flat tick for every price, so any positive reference price resolves to the same band
sources: NSE/CMTR/44481 Capital Market Consolidated Circular, Circular Ref 39/2020, dated 2020-05-27, item 3.3 Tick Size (tick for all Exchange Traded Fund instruments is one paise except for Gold ETFs): https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/content/circulars/CMTR44481.zip (fetched 2026-10-06)

NSE/CMTR/57270 Capital Market Consolidated Circular, Circular Ref 75/2023, dated 2023-06-26, item 3.3 Tick Size (tick for Exchange Traded Fund instruments is one paise; Gold ETFs follow their own trading parameters): https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/content/circulars/CMTR57270.zip (fetched 2026-10-06)

NSE/CMTR/61813 Capital Market Consolidated Circular, Circular Ref 59/2024, dated 2024-04-29, item 3.3 Tick Size (same wording as 57270): https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/content/circulars/CMTR61813.zip (fetched 2026-10-06)

NSE/CMTR/62174 Revision in tick size of securities in CM segment, Circular Ref 66/2024, dated 2024-05-24, effective 2024-06-10, applies to all securities excluding Exchange Traded Funds: https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/content/circulars/CMTR62174.pdf (fetched 2026-10-06)

NSE/CMTR/67133 Revision in tick size of securities in CM segment - Update, Circular Ref 33/2025, dated 2025-03-13, effective 2025-04-15, restates the Exchange Traded Fund exclusion: https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/content/circulars/CMTR67133.pdf (fetched 2026-10-06)

NSE/CMTR/67774 Capital Market Consolidated Circular, Circular Ref 48/2025, dated 2025-04-30, item 3.3 B (price-linked table excludes Exchange Traded Funds) and item 1.22 (ETF tick Rs 0.01 or Rs 0.05 as per the respective ETF): https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/content/circulars/CMTR67774.zip (fetched 2026-10-06)
